about.heading: About
paragraphs:
Nice to meet you.
I'm Takumi Ishii.

Born in 2003 and raised in the Kansai region, I study Computer Science at Kwansei Gakuin University while singing with the Kwansei Gakuin Glee Club — Japan's oldest male-voice choir — where I've thrown myself wholeheartedly into choral music.

I began singing in junior high and have been involved as both a performer and a coach. Getting through the harsh restrictions of the pandemic and devoting four university years to song was an irreplaceable part of my youth. In the club I served as part leader and head of the IT department, supporting the group through both performance and organizational management. Though I'm an alumnus now, I keep singing quietly while supporting the younger members.

At the same time, I've kept honing my craft in computer science. In high school, when the pandemic made it impossible to hold the culture festival's on-site stage, I planned and designed a live online broadcast and produced videos so that as many people as possible could still enjoy it. At university, I've continued to deliver solutions across many environments and approaches, coexisting and thriving alongside AI.

Layering voices in an ensemble, and stacking logic in engineering. Two pursuits that seem never to meet — yet in drawing on individual strengths to build a single whole, they are, to me, one continuous act.

closing.line: To give feelings without an outline the shape of a voice.
To give the skills and knowledge I hold the meaning of a solution.

award.title: Gold Award, All-Japan Choral Competition — University Youth Division
award.description: As part leader and head of the IT department at Kwansei Gakuin Glee Club, contributed to winning the Gold Award in the University Youth Division of the 2025 All-Japan Choral Competition. As head of IT, I digitized attendance tracking, sheet-music sharing, and rehearsal records that had previously been handled on paper or by word of mouth — driving the club's internal DX and building an environment that made the most of our limited rehearsal time. Beyond performing as a singer, I supported the whole ensemble from behind the scenes by improving practice efficiency, helping earn the Gold Award.
award.imageAlt: Group photo at the award ceremony

expo-pr.title: Expo 2025 Osaka PR Video (commissioned by the Embassy of Croatia)
expo-pr.description: Commissioned by the Embassy of Croatia, I produced a PR video introducing Kwansei Gakuin Glee Club for its appearance at the Croatia National Day of Expo 2025 Osaka. I created two versions — a Japanese edition for domestic audiences and an English edition for international visitors and viewers. From audio editing in Steinberg Cubase to video editing in Adobe Premiere Pro and motion graphics in After Effects, I handled the entire process from concept to final cut, putting my creative production skills to work.
expo-pr.imageAlt: Photo taken while singing for the PR video

youtube.title: Kwansei Gakuin Glee Club / Shingetsukai Official YouTube Channel
youtube.description: I plan and run the official YouTube channel of Kwansei Gakuin Glee Club and its alumni chorus, Shingetsukai. As the club's PR lead, I handle everything from content planning and filming to publishing and channel design — aiming not only to reach existing fans but to win new audiences and build recognition both in Japan and abroad. Thinking hard about how to convey the identity of a performing ensemble, I've built practical experience in branding and public relations.

attendance-system.title: Attendance & Student Management System for a Tutoring School
attendance-system.description: At the private tutoring school where I work part-time, I rebuilt the previously paper-based student management and instructor attendance tracking as a web application. By eliminating manual tallying and transcription, I achieved on-the-ground DX and greater operational efficiency, and I now continue to operate and maintain it as an officially sanctioned tool of the head office. Having driven everything myself — from planning and design to development and operation — it's an example of real-world, production-level development skill.
